To whom it may concern,  

Linda and I have collaborated daily at NordicShop Ltd. for over two years, primarily on data infrastructure projects. As a peer, I’ve observed her technical rigor and collaborative mindset firsthand.  

Linda’s strength lies in her ability to translate complex data challenges into scalable solutions. She recently led the redesign of our ETL pipelines, integrating Apache Spark and Kafka to process 10x more transactions daily. Her work reduced latency by over 40%, which directly boosted our analytics team’s capacity. She also spearheaded a Snowflake-to-AWS migration, optimizing query performance through thoughtful data modeling. Beyond technical skills, Linda’s reliability and curiosity make her a natural collaborator—she’ll often troubleshoot issues across teams without being asked.  

A standout moment was when she debugged a critical Kafka streaming fault during a major product launch. Instead of escalating, she spent hours analyzing logs, eventually identifying a misconfigured partition. Her calm under pressure ensured minimal downtime. Similarly, her Terraform expertise streamlined our cloud infrastructure, cutting deployment errors by nearly half.  

Linda’s work ethic is equally impressive. She consistently volunteers to mentor junior engineers, sharing insights on best practices without assuming superiority. Her contributions have been instrumental in shaping our data strategy, and I’m confident she’ll bring the same dedication to any new role.  

Sincerely,  
[Your Name]  
[Your Title/Position]
